title: Cousin Henry's looks and his surviving sister
summary: Henry was young and handsome; his sister is a church pianist.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: He wasn't that crazy. Mm-hmm. Oh, how old was your cousin Henry when he died?
No. I don't know. He wasn't an old man.
His daddy was alive, you think?
Oh, yeah. His daddy was my uncle. His daddy. What's the matter?
Nothing.
Who was on the phone?
Somebody. Yeah. His dad might be sick. Well, you are. You think he was older than you or younger than you?
I think he was younger than I was.
So he must have been mighty young when he died.

Yeah, he was younger than I was. He was a good looking. He wasn't no taller than you, though. He was lower than you're built. He was still good looking. Women used to call that a beauty rest. He was a good looking colored boy. He really was good looking. Beautiful teeth. Perfect nose and mouth. He was good looking. His mama's dead now, too.
Is your daddy dead?
Yeah, yeah. They dead. They both are dead.
Do they have any brothers and sisters alive?
He got one sister. She's still alive. And you know where she is? Yeah, she lives back on. She bought a house back on Hamptonshire.
Hamilton? Mm-hmm. You know when it's near? No, I don't. Well, maybe we can take a ride out there sometime and see your cousin.
Well, I don't know exactly what's near it. Mm-hmm. I know it's going to happen.

You'd know it if you saw it? Oh, yeah. Well, we'll try to get a ride out there. You'll see anyone who can talk to her, because I know she'd like to have something, you know, about her brother to be saved about him.
Yeah.
Because he was certainly a well-known musician.
Oh, yeah.
A well-respected woman.
She's a musician, too. She used to play for Plymouth Rock Baptist Church. She played piano.
Mm-hmm.
She played. Wonderful.
